note: T055, F141-FR-020. The component-name table of feature 100, annex X §X.8, names each as-is implementation in PROSE ("The pass-loop script"); the rule N-15 replaces a PREFIX of a message, which is a file name. This file is the one fact feature 100's table does not carry: which file of each pinned baseline each of its rows names. It is a record of the reference trees at the pinned commits of `pins.json` and no table of normalization: the as-is-to-logical mapping stays feature 100's and is read from `normalization.json` (F141-FR-020, "MUST hold no table of its own"). One entry per row of that table, in the order of the annex; `test/normalize/rules.test.ts` holds the two to each other and checks every file against the reference tree. The five file names that F100-FR-026 reserves to `packages/contracts/data/layout-old-side.json` are NOT copied here: a row that names one gives the behaviour item of that file instead (`filesFromOldSide`), and `componentFiles()` reads the name out of the one file that may carry it, joining it to the directories the row names.
